title: B1 ResultEnvelope accepted directory-shaped artifact claims until final verification
discovered_by: actual Phase F B1 R4 run
symptom: R03 public work and diff checks passed post hoc, but B1 blocked before checks because two declared artifacts were directory paths
reproduction: Return a completed ResultEnvelope whose artifacts.path names an existing directory

evidence.detail: R4 attempt_finished recorded artifact_corrupt at declared_artifacts with message declared Artifact missing for the generated fixture directory

root_cause: The public Schema and Worker prompt described artifacts.path only as a relative path while final verification silently required an existing regular file

considered_options.reason: expands the frozen Evidence contract and is unnecessary for this correction

considered_options.option: make the regular-file contract explicit and resume once with precise guidance
considered_options.reason: preserves file hashing while letting the Worker correct metadata

resolution: Document the regular-file-only rule in Pydantic Schema and prompt, detect an existing directory immediately after result parsing, and send retryable same-session guidance to use a concrete manifest or index file
verification: Targeted prompt, Schema, and Fake correction tests: 7 passed
R4 post-hoc R03 public contract and diff checks both passed without a model turn
remaining_risks: The sealed R4 result remains blocked and is not rewritten; a fresh R5 live run needs separate model-use approval
